chunks: If you call them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you call them or hold your tongue.

key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: It is all the same / equal

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says it is the same whether you call disbelievers or hold your tongue?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *tabligh* (conveyance) as the Prophet's primary duty, distinguishing it from *ta'sir* (causing guidance), which belongs to Allah. It reassures the believer that the efficacy of da'wah is not contingent upon the immediate acceptance of the audience, thereby validating the persistence of the caller even in the face of obstinate rejection.
